title: Reference or Project Material
description: A source excerpt or trace used as material for literary inquiry, not a verdict or proof of AI subjectivity.

source_note.description: Existing ResearchOS interpretation, kept as a historical note rather than adopted as fact.

verification.description: SESSION-027 (2026-10-23) 追加。書誌そのものの照合状態。source の存在ではなく、source を実際に開いたかどうかを記録する。

depth.description: How deep the check went, not merely whether some check happened (2026-11-20, §3 of the evidence-accounting change). `unspecified` means the record does not say (legacy rows, and corrections that withdraw an *inferred* depth): it is never satisfied as a new row's answer and never means full_text. metadata = bibliographic record only; abstract = abstract or summary prose; results = results table or key figure; full_text = the passage was read in the paper's own text; re_derived = the number was recomputed from the paper's reported data. Required from 2026-11-21 when verification.checked_at is on or after that date; absent on older rows means 'not recorded', never 'full_text'.

quote_status.description: Reality-monitoring witness for `passage` (2026-11-25, cross-semantic invariant gate). `verbatim` = passage is a direct verbatim excerpt from the primary text (may contain `...`/`…` ellipses between ordered verbatim clauses); `paraphrase_summary` = passage is an explicit editorial summary/paraphrase (must carry an explicit summary marker); `mixed` = editorial summary prose embedding >=1 inline quoted verbatim span; `none` = empty passage. Required from 2026-11-26 on new `research_excerpt` / `literary_text` rows with `status == 'verified'` and `depth in ('full_text', 'results')`.

span_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical normalized verbatim span(s) in `passage`, emitted by `python3 tools/three_gates.py --verify-span` after verifying contiguous substring presence against the fetched primary text. Recomputed offline in CI (`validate_seed.py` / `three_gates.py --check`).

span_norm_chars.description: Character length of the canonical normalized verbatim span(s) hashed in `span_sha256`.
